market_mechanics.cadence: 5-min slots pre-created; next slot listed & tradable before current closes (timeline endpoint)

market_mechanics.oracle: pythAddress also present; chartSource=chainlink; streamType twap in metadata.chainlinkDataStream
market_mechanics.orderbook: YES-side LIVE GTC book; minSize=50 shares; maxSpread=0.065; price ticks 0.001

slot_metadata_flags.note: 5-min series is a Polymarket mirror; Limitless runs its own internal MM; taker delay is an anti-latency-arb measure; no LP rewards on 5m/15m

new_venues_since_2026_10_14.taker: 5% x (1 - price) of USDC value, both sides, paid in USDC via feeModule 0x7B6ffe5bA8B5ec7afB0AaBaE629D12dA5bC62565 (simple) / 0x01b7dF643247B377D5c39FcC40b9c28B4A827524 (NegRisk)
new_venues_since_2026_10_14.formula: fee = rate_bps * N * (S - N) / (10000 * S); N=USDC notional, S=shares; round half-up to 10 raw units
new_venues_since_2026_10_14.buy_reserve: 5% of order amount held as fee reserve
new_venues_since_2026_10_14.signing: feeRateBps=0 in EIP-712 order on new venues

fees.rebates: 100% of eligible taker fees on Daily/Hourly/15-min Crypto fund maker pool; daily USDC payout pro-rata
fees.points_program: GET /portfolio/points: currentSeason + archived season1/2/3+; isRewardable=True on 5-min slots accrues points; UGM excluded since Sep 2026
